scope: PR #292 Docker browser lab and confirmed browser evidence

tests.name: docker-browser-lab-smoke
tests.evidence: Cloud runner validated Compose, started nginx, Chromium and Firefox, probed all endpoints, archived logs, and cleaned up successfully.

tests.name: browser-desktop-auth-boundary
tests.evidence: Chromium and Firefox HTTPS desktop endpoints both returned the expected authenticated HTTP 401 boundary.

tests.name: security-contract
tests.evidence: The initial secret-scan finding was caused by a password-like development value; an explicit placeholder was committed and the repeated security contract passed.

tests.name: application-javascript-change-attribution
tests.evidence: The PR changes QA workflow, Compose, nginx configuration, documentation and npm aliases; it does not change application JavaScript.

tests.name: lighthouse-total-js-budget
tests.evidence: Total JavaScript is 22,139 bytes versus a 21,021-byte reviewed baseline: +5.32% against a 5% budget. The same generated application assets exist independently of this QA-only PR.
